title: {channel} song requests and Spotify queue | ItsBagelBot
metaDescription: See what is playing on {channel}'s Twitch stream and what plays next. Request a Spotify song in chat with !sr. Updated live.
aboutBody: {channel} takes Spotify song requests through ItsBagelBot, a free Twitch chat bot. Type !sr with a song name, "artist - song" or a Spotify link in the Twitch chat. Requests play in order on the streamer's Spotify.
aboutLink: Add song requests to your channel
tagline: What is playing and what plays next, updated live.
requestHint: Request a song from chat with !sr <song>.
boardNote: First requested, first played. Shows the next {max} songs.
noMatchBody: No song in the queue matches that search.
emptyBody: When viewers request songs, they show up here.
degraded: The queue can't load right now. This page keeps trying.
